title: createRequestHandler
summary: Create Node/Express middleware for SSR documents and loader/action HTTP requests.

sections.title: Options
sections.body: build exports default(request, entry) and handleDataRequest(request), each returning a Response or Promise<Response>. entry is the deployed browser entry URL from the Vite manifest. See the Express and Node hosting guide for a complete server.
sections.code:
import { createRequestHandler } from "@kasperrt/smolter/utils/http";

app.use(createRequestHandler({ build, entry: "/assets/client.js" }));

sections.title: Middleware order
sections.body: Mount Prometheus, tracing, authentication, body size limits and static serving first. Do not consume the request stream with a body parser before this middleware. Errors are passed to next(error). Express trust proxy remains your application’s responsibility. The adapter does not start a server, install Prometheus, or depend on Express.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Route data uses the reserved .__smolter suffix. /users.__smolter?page=2 dispatches /users?page=2; /users/.__smolter preserves the trailing slash. Document requests call build.default. Explicit dataEndpoint retains legacy ?url= transport. Invalid targets return 400. Data responses use private, no-store. Apply authorization to both representations; reserve the suffix in Express/static middleware. Client disconnection aborts the Request; responses stream with backpressure.

sections.title: Early shell interactivity
sections.body: Configure earlyHydration on renderApplication in your server entry, not on this middleware. Keep reverse-proxy buffering disabled if the shell must arrive before optional data. The adapter respects response backpressure and flushes compression when the response provides flush(). A disconnected browser aborts the request and cancels its response reader.
